criterionOutcomes.criterion: When a completed Call test is opened in the shared point-detail dialog, its summary shows the available duration, test result, connection time, start time, end time, handset, and disconnection cause.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-summary.png shows Success, Connection Time 984, start/end 10:41:30–10:41:50 and a blank disconnection-cause field, but no Duration or Handset in the captured summary. The timestamps establish measurable duration; the blank cause alone is not a defect.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When Call samples are returned, the timeline chart shows call state, service technology, and signal strength across the test duration.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-before-hover-chart.png and criterion-2-final.png show signal strength over seconds with call-initiation, connection and end annotations. The chart legend and hovered tooltip show only Signal strength; service technology appears in the table, not across the timeline.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When Call samples are returned, the dialog displays them in a table whose columns can be sorted and filtered.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-before-time-header-click.png and criterion-3-final.png show plain headers and the same first sample (10:41:30.420) after the reported Time click. Only one row is visible, with no complete ordering comparison or filtering interaction/state; these captures do not establish that sorting and filtering work or conclusively prove their absence.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: For each displayed Call sample, the Serving Cell column shows the known serving site/cell when available; when it is unavailable, it shows that sample’s CGI.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-4-cgi-fallback.png and criterion-4-final.png show CGI 234-30-3369473 in the visible sample of two calls. No independently verified known-serving-site/cell fixture was established, so the known-cell branch and per-sample mapping rule cannot be assessed.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Selecting a displayed Call sample opens the related Service details for the selected sample’s point in time.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-5-before-select-sample.png shows the 10:41:30.420 sample with −57 dBm and CGI 234-30-3369473; criterion-5-after-select-radio-details.png and criterion-5-final-selected-measurement.png show opened radio details with matching RSRP −57 dBm and CI 3369473. The recorded selection request uses sampleTime 2026-10-06T10:41:30.4200000.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When the selected Call point has no measurable duration, the dialog shows the standard no-data state instead of an empty detail view.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-6-completed-call-has-duration.png shows a populated 20-second call. The reported Setup Failures load returned HTTP 200 with points:[]; criterion-6-final.png shows the filtered map with no selectable call. No zero-duration fixture was available to open the required no-data dialog.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: While Call details are loading, the dialog shows the standard loading state; when details are unavailable, it shows the standard no-data state; when loading fails, it shows the standard error state, with no incorrect Call data displayed.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-7-after-open-event.png and criterion-7-final.png already show populated Call details. The loading state was not captured, and controlled unavailable-details/error fixtures were not available; the required loading, no-data and error states remain unassessed.
